Check Engine SEO 1.3.160

**Check Engine is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *New name: Docket SEO is now Check Engine SEO.* The window, reports, messages and help use the new name, and the website is now checkengineseo.com (docketseo.app forwards there). Your licence key, settings and past reports carry over unchanged. On the command line the command is now `checkengine`; `docket` still works as the same command.
- *White-label reports leave the audited site's own words alone.* When a report carries an agency's name, the product's own sentences say "this audit", and nothing the audited site wrote is ever rewritten (a site called "Check Engine Light Repair" now keeps its name in a client's report).
- *A failed audit leaves a message.* If a site cannot be reached, the reason now stays under the address field after the notice disappears, instead of vanishing with it.
- *Look and feel, from a design review.* The Reports tab has a proper layout and a "Start an audit" button when it is empty; the Watchlist's empty state is centred and its placeholder is readable; an invalid address is marked on the field; buttons and inputs have clearer edges in light and dark mode; the tabs no longer jump when a crawl starts; the header fits the smallest window; animations stop for people who have asked for less motion.
- *Windows.* The installer updates in place over 1.3.159, adds a `checkengine` command beside `docket`, and the AI-assistant (MCP) setup help appears only on Windows, with the exact paths that were tested.
- *Fixes.* The read-only-location message now says "drag the app", matching what Finder shows; licence messages use the new name; the code-scanning (SARIF) output keeps its tool name so existing alerts are not re-raised.

99 checks across 13 areas.
